## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
source(here("setup.R"))
source(here("functions", "data_cleaners.R"))
source(here("functions", "lfs_panel.R"))

```

```{r}
aps2019 <- read_csv("../data/aps2019_shrunk_decoded.csv") %>%
  mutate(native = BIRTHCTRY_LABEL=="UK",
         EU = str_detect(BIRTHCTRY_LABEL, "EU"), 
         non_EU = !native & !EU & !is.na(BIRTHCTRY_LABEL)) %>% 
  group_by(REGION) %>%
  summarise(
    native_share = sum(native, na.rm = TRUE),
    EU_share = sum(EU, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_EU_share = sum(non_EU, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  glimpse


aps2021 <- read_csv("../data/aps2021_shrunk_decoded.csv") %>%
  mutate(native = BIRTHCTRY_LABEL=="UK",
         EU = str_detect(BIRTHCTRY_LABEL, "EU"), 
         non_EU = !native & !EU & !is.na(BIRTHCTRY_LABEL)) %>% 
  group_by(REGION) %>%
  summarise(
    native_share = sum(native, na.rm = TRUE),
    EU_share = sum(EU, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_EU_share = sum(non_EU, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(aps2019, by = "REGION", suffix = c(".19", ".21")) %>%
  glimpse
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df_change <- aps2021 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -REGION,
    names_to = c("category", "year"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_share\\.(19|21)",
    values_to = "share"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = share
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    change = ((`21` - `19`)/`19`)* 100,
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = c("native", "EU", "non_EU")
    )
  )

ggplot(df_change, aes(
  x = reorder(REGION, change),
  y = change,
  fill = category
)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Population Composition by Region",
    subtitle = "2019–2021",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Change (percentage points)",
    fill = "Birthplace"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
